description: Environmental and electrical data acquisition system of a photovoltaic system in Pamplona, Norte de Santander, Colombia. Environmental and electrical data acquisition system of a photovoltaic system in Pamplona, Norte de is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Aldo Pardo Garcia, LUIS ERNESTO NEIRA ROPERO (University of Pamplona). Environmental and electrical data acquisition system for a photovoltaic system in Pamplona, Norte de Santander, Colombia. The system captures environmental variables such as temperature, humidity, and irradiance, as well as electrical variables of voltage and current at the input and output of the photovoltaic converter and charge controller.The photovoltaic panels are 100W monocrystalline RTM100M. Coverage: national (CO); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
